description: This file defines the SqlsrvManager class, a PHP class extending MssqlManager, providing SQL Server database management functionalities including connection handling, query execution, schema inspection, error handling, and transaction verification, specifically for the 'sqlsrv' driver within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: SqlsrvManager
classes.description: A PHP class managing SQL Server database operations using the 'sqlsrv' extension, including connection, querying, schema inspection, error handling, and transaction verification, tailored for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQL Server database using provided configuration options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, supporting array input and handling query timing and error checking.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about fields in a result set, optionally converting field names to lowercase.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a result set as an associative array, cleaning up space-only varchar values.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a string to a SQL expression based on the specified data type, with special handling for datetime.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions, with special handling for 'id' type fields.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getConstraintSql
methods.description: Generates SQL for table constraints, ensuring a clustered index exists.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message, filtering out non-critical messages.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database server and client.

methods.name: verifyGenericQueryRollback
methods.description: Executes a data manipulation query within a transaction, then rolls back to verify correctness.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Verifies an INSERT query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Verifies an UPDATE query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Verifies a DELETE query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the 'sqlsrv' extension is available for use.
